data.contenido:
Aantu owala yahetatu ya hupithwa kEyelu, ihe mepitathimbo yo oyi indjipala sigo omayuvi ogendji. Opo nduno, oomvula 352 konima yEyelu, Abraham okwa valwa. Tse otatu ilongo nkene Kalunga a ­gwanitha euvaneko lye mokupa Abraham omumati gwedhina Isaak. Opo nduno, maamati yaali yaIsaak, Kalunga okwa hogolola mo Jakob.

Jakob okwa li e na uukwanegumbo owindji aamati 12 naakadhona yontumba. Aamati 10 yaJakob oya tondo omumwahe ondenge yawo Josef, noye mu landitha po omupika muEgipiti. Konima Josef okwa ningi omupangeli a simana gwaEgipiti. Sho ondjala onene ye ya, Josef okwa makele aamwahe okutala ngele omitima dhawo odha lunduluka tuu. Lwahugunina uukwanegumbo auhe waJakob, Aaisrael, owa tembu­kile kuEgipiti. Shika osha ningwa moomvula 290 konima sho Abraham a valwa.

Oomvula 215 dha landula ko Aaisrael oya kala muEgipiti. Konima yeso lyaJosef, yo oya ningi aapika hoka. Konima yethimbo Moses okwa valwa, Kalunga nokwe mu longitha okumangulula Aaisrael muEgipiti. Oomvula 857 adhihe kumwe dhondjokonona otadhi hokololwa mOshitopolwa OSHITIYALI.

OWA tseya mbela oshinima shotango shono Noa a ningi sho ye nuukwanegumbo we ya zi monguluwato? Ye okwe etele Kalunga eyambo nenge omagano. Mefano pevi ngoye oto vulu okumona nkene te shi ningi. Noa okwa yamba omagano ngaka giinamwenyo okupandula Kalunga molwashono a hupitha uukwanegumbo we meyelu enene.

Mbela oto dhiladhila kutya Jehova omagano okwa li e ga hokwa? Eeno, okwa li e ga hokwa. Nokwa li ano u uvanekele Noa kutya ye ita ka hanagula po we nando uuyuni neyelu.



Mbala evi olya li lya kukuta thiluthilu, Noa nuukwanegumbo we noya tameke onkalamwenyo ompe pondje yonguluwato. Kalunga okwe ya yambeke nokwe ya lombwele: ‘Ne omu na okukala mu na aanona oyendji. Omu na okwiindjipala sigo taku kala aantu oyendji kombanda yevi alihe.’

Ihe konima, sho aantu ye ku uva kombinga yeyelu enene, otashi vulika yo oya li taa ka kala ya tila noonkondo kutya eyelu lya fa ndyoka onali ka ningwa ishewe. Ano Kalunga okwa gandja sha shoka tashi ka dhimbulukitha aantu keuvaneko lye kutya ye ita ka yelula we nando evi alihe. Owa tseya mbela shoka ye a gandja oku ya dhimbulukitha? Osha li uutamvula.

Uutamvula olundji ohau monika kegulu uuna etango tali minikile konima yokuloka. Omautamvula oge na omalwaala ogendji omawanawa. Ngoye mbela owa mona nale wumwe? Ou wete wumwe mefano?

Kalunga okwa ti ngeyi: ‘Otandi uvaneke kutya aantu ayehe niinamwenyo itaa ka hanagulwa po we nando keyelu. Otandi tula uutamvula wandje miikogo. Nuuna uutamvula tau holoka, otandi u mono notandi dhimbulukwa euvaneko ndika lyandje.’

Ano uuna ngoye to mono uutamvula, oshike tau ke ku dhimbulukitha? Eeno, euvaneko lyaKalunga kutya ye ita ka hanagula po we nando uuyuni neyelu enene. Genesis 8:18-22; 9:9-17.

OOMVULA odhindji odha piti po. Oyanamati yaNoa oya li ye na aanona oyendji. Naanona yawo oya koko nayo wo oya li ye na aanona. Mbala okwa li ku na aantu oyendji kombanda yevi.

Gumwe gwomaantu mbaka okwa li omutekulululwa gwaNoa gwedhina Nimrod. Ye okwa li omulumentu omwiinayi ngoka a yewe nokwa dhipaga iinamwenyo nosho wo aantu. Nimrod okwi iningi wo ye mwene omukwaniilwa okupangela aantu yalwe. Kalunga ka li e hole Nimrod. Aantu ayehe pethimbo ndyono oya li haa popi elaka limwe. Nimrod okwa li a hala e ya gongele ayehe pamwe opo a vule oku ya pangela. Ano owa tseya ngaa shoka a ningi po? Ye okwa lombwele aantu ya tunge oshilando noshungo onene musho. Ou ya wete mefano nkene taa ningi oondhopi.

Jehova Kalunga ka li nando a hokwa etungo ndika. Kalunga okwa li a hala aantu ye endaende noya kale kevi alihe. Ihe aantu oya ti: ‘Ileni! Tu tungeni oshilando noshungo onde ngaaka ndjoka ondungu yayo tayi ka tsa megulu. Nopo nduno tatu ka kala aanamadhina!’ Aantu oya li ya hala ya konge esimano lyawo yene, halyaKalunga.

Ano Kalunga okwe ethitha po aantu iilonga yokutunga oshungo. Owa tseya mbela nkene e shi ningi? Omokuningitha mbalambala aantu ya popye omalaka ga yoolokathana, pehala owala lyalimwe. Aatungi kaya li we yu uvitathane omukwawo nomukwawo. Shika osho molwashono oshilando shawo shi ithanwa Babel, nenge Babilon, tashi ti “Evundakano.”

Ngashingeyi aantu oya tameke okutembuka muBabel. Uungundu waantu mboka haa popi elaka limwe oya yi ya ka kale pamwe moshitopolwa shimwe shevi. Genesis 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9.

LIMWE lyomomahala moka aantu ya yi ya ka kale konima yEyelu olya li lyi ithanwa Ur. Olya ningi oshilando sha simana shi na omagumbo omawanawa musho. Ihe aantu mono oya li haa galikana iikalunga. Shika osho wo ya li ya ningi muBabel. Aantu yomuUr naBabel kaya li nando ngaashi Noa nomwanamati Sem, mboka ya li ya tsikile nokulongela Jehova.

Lwahugunina, oomvula 350 konima yeyelu, Noa omudhiginini okwa si. Osha li owala konima yoomvula mbali sho omulumentu ngoka u wete mefano ndika a valwa. Ye okwa li omuntu i ili lela kuKalunga. Edhina lye olya li Abraham. Ye okwa kala nuukwanegumbo we moshilando shaUr.

Esiku limwe Jehova okwa lombwele Abraham: ‘Thiga po Ur naakweni, na inda koshilongo shoka tandi ke ku ulukila.’ Mbela Abraham okwa vulika ngaa kuKalunga nokuthiga po omauwanawa agehe gomuUr? Eeno, ye osho a ningi. Nosha li molwashoka Abraham aluhe okwa li a vulika kuKalunga ye okwa tseyika ngashingeyi oye kuume kaKalunga.

Yamwe yomaakwanegumbo lyaAbraham oya yi pamwe naye sho a thigi po Ur, muyo omwa li he Tarah nomutekulu Lot. Nopwaa na omalimbililo, nomukiintu gwaAbraham Sara okwa yi wo pamwe nayo. Mepitathimbo yo ayehe oye ya pehala lyi ithanwa Haran, moka Tarah a sile. Oya li kokule naUr.

Konima yethimbo Abraham nuukwanegumbo we oya thigi po Haran noya yi koshilongo shi ithanwa Kanaan. Hoka Jehova okwa ti: ‘Shika osho oshilongo tandi ke shi pa aanona yoye.’ Abraham okwa kala muKanaan nokwa kala metsali.

Kalunga okwa tameke okukwatha Abraham opo a ninge uusita uunene woonzi niinamwenyo yilwe naapika omathele. Ihe ye naSara kaya li ye na aanona yawo yene.

Sho Abraham a li e na oomvula 99, Jehova okwa ti: ‘Otandi ku uvanekele kutya ngoye oto ka ninga he yaantu yiigwana oyindji.’ Ihe ongiini shika tashi vulu okuningwa, molwashoka Abraham naSara oya li pethimbo ndyono ya kulupa noonkondo okumona aanona? Genesis 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19.

OTO vulu mbela okumona shoka Abraham ta ningi mpaka? Ye oku na oshimbele, notashi monika a fa a hala okudhipaga omwanamati. Omolwashike mbela ye a hala okuninga oshinima sha tya ngawo? Tango, natu tale nkene Abraham naSara ya mono okamwanamati kawo.

Dhimbulukwa, Kalunga okwe ya uvanekele kutya otaa ka mona okamati. Ihe osha li sha fa itaashi vulika, oshoka Abraham naSara oya li ya kulupa ngawo. Nonando ongawo, Abraham okwi itaala kutya Kalunga iha nyengwa kusha. Ano oshike sha ningwa po?

Konima sho Kalunga a ningi euvaneko lye, opwa piti uule womvula. Nopo nduno, sho Abraham a li e na oomvula 100 naSara oomvula 90, oya mono okahanona okamati kedhina Isaak. Kalunga okwa gwanitha euvaneko lye!

Ihe Isaak sho a koko, Jehova okwa makele eitaalo lyaAbraham. Ye okwi ithana: ‘Abraham!’ Abraham nokwi itaale: ‘Ongame nguka!’ Nopo nduno Kalunga okwa ti: ‘Kutha omumwoye, omumwoye epona, Isaak, e to yi kondundu ndjoka tandi ke ku ulukila. Dhipaga hoka omumwoye noku mu yamba oye eyambo.’

Alikana oohapu ndhika odha li dhe ehameke Abraham ngiini, oshoka Abraham okwa li e hole omwanamati noonkondo. Dhimbulukwa wo, Kalunga oku uvaneke kutya aanona yaAbraham otaya ka kala moshilongo shaKanaan. Ihe osha li tashi vulu okuningwa ngiini ngele Isaak okwa si? Abraham ka li e shi uvite ko, ihe natango okwa vulika kuKalunga.

Sho e ya pondundu, Abraham okwa manga Isaak nokwe mu tula kondjambelo ndjoka ye a tungu. Nopo nduno ta kutha mo oshimbele okudhipaga omwanamati. Ihe pokathimbo oko tuu hono omuyengeli gwaKalunga okwi ithana: ‘Abraham, Abraham!’ Abraham nokwi itaale: ‘Ongame nguka!’

‘Ino ehameka omumati nenge u mu ningile sha,’ Kalunga osho a ti. ‘Ngashingeyi onda tseya kutya owi itaala ndje, molwashoka ino indikila ndje omumwoye, epona lyoye.’

Alikana eitaalo oli thike peni Abraham a li e na muKalunga! Ye okwi itaala kutya kapwa li sha tashi vulu okunyenga Jehova, nonokutya Jehova ota vulu nokuli okuyumudha Isaak kuusi. Ihe Kalunga ka li a hala lelalela Abraham a dhipage Isaak. Ano Kalunga okwa patekenitha onzi moshihwa shimwe sha li popepi, nokwa lombwele Abraham oku yi yamba pehala lyomwanamati. Genesis 21:1-7; 22:1-18.

LOT nuukwanegumbo we oya kala pamwe naAbraham moshilongo shaKanaan. Esiku limwe Abraham okwa ti kuLot: ‘Kapu na mpaka oshilongo sha gwanena iimuna yetu ayihe. Alikana, tu topoke. Ngele ngoye to ka ya nombinga yimwe ngame otandi ka ya nonkwawo.’

Lot okwa tala oshilongo akuhe. Okwa mono oshitopolwa oshiwanawa unene shoshilongo shoka sha li shi na omeya nomwiidhi omwaanawa ogundji gwiimuna. Shika osha li Esilukuti lyaJordan. Ano Lot nuukwanegumbo we niimuna ye oya tembukile hoka. Lwahugunina oya ningi ehala lyawo lyokukala moshilongo shaSodom.

Aantu yomuSodom oya li aawinayi noonkondo. Shika oshu uvitha nayi Lot, oshoka ye okwa li omulumentu omwaanawa. Kalunga wo okwa li e uvite nayi. Lwahugunina Kalunga okwa tumu aayengeli okulondodha Lot kutya ye ota ka hanagula po Sodom noshilando shomuushiinda Gomorra molwuuwinayi wayo.

Aayengeli oya lombwele Lot: ‘Endelela! Kutha omukiintu gwoye naamwoyekadhona yaali nomu ze mo mehala ndika!’ Lot nuukwanegumbo we oya li taa kakadhala okuya, onkee ano aayengeli oye ya kwata moshikaha noye ya kutha mo moshilongo. Nopo nduno gumwe gwomaayengeli okwa ti: ‘Fadhukii po omolwoomwenyo dheni! Inamu tala konima. Matukileni koondundu, opo mwaa dhipagwe.’ Lot noyanakadhona oya vulika noya fadhuka po okuza muSodom. Yo inaa thikama nando oko okathimbo, noinaa tala konima. Ihe omukiintu gwaLot okwa li inaa vulika. Konima sho ya yi oshikako okuza muSodom, ye okwa thikama nokwa tala konima. Nopo nduno omukiintu gwaLot okwa ningi oshaanda shomongwa. Oto vulu mbela oku mu mona mpaka mefano?

Tse otatu vulu okwiilonga oshilongwa oshiwanawa mushika. Otashi tu ulukile kutya Kalunga oha hupitha mboka haa vulika kuye, ihe mboka itaa vulika kuye otaa ka kanitha oomwenyo dhawo. Genesis 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Lukas 17:28-32; 2 Petrus 2:6-8.

OWA tseya kutya omukiintu mefano ndino oye lye? Edhina lye oRebeka. Nomulumentu ngoka ye ta yi a ka tsakaneke, oIsaak. Ye ota ka ninga omukiintu gwe. Ongiini shika sha ningwa?

He yaIsaak Abraham okwa halele okumonena omwanamati omukiintu omwaanawa. Ye ka li a hala Isaak a hokane nagumwe gwomaakiintu yomuKanaan, oshoka aantu mbaka ohaa galikana iikalunga. Ano Abraham okwiithana omupiya gwe nokwa ti: ‘Onda hala u shune kuHaran hoka aakwetu ya kala nokumonena ko omumwandje omumati Isaak omukiintu.’

Omupiya gwaAbraham okwa kutha mbalambala oongamelo omulongo nokuya molweendo olule. Sho e ya popepi nehala moka aakwawo yaAbraham ya kala, ye okwa tula pomuthima. Okwa li kwa toka komatango, ethimbo ndyono uuna aakiintu yomoshilando haye ya okuteka omeya komuthima. Ano omupiya gwaAbraham okwa galikana kuJehova a ti: ‘Omukiintu ngoka ta tekele ndje omeya noongamelo dhandje na ninge gumwe ngoka to hogolola a ninge omukiintu gwaIsaak.’

Mbala konima yokathimbo okwa zi Rebeka e ya okuteka omeya. Sho omupiya e mu pula omeya gokunwa, ye okwe mu pe. Nopo nduno okwa yi nokwa hugile oongamelo adhihe dha li dha sa enota omeya ga gwana. Osha li iilonga iidhigu oshoka oongamelo ohadhi nu omeya ogendji.

Sho Rebeka a mana okuninga shika, omupiya gwaAbraham okwe mu pula edhina lyahe. Okwa pula wo ngele ota vulu okulala uusiku maandjawo. Ye okwa ti: ‘Tate oBetuel, nomu na ehala lyoye okukala putse.’ Omupiya gwaAbraham okwa li e shi kutya Betuel omwanamati gomumwayina gwaAbraham Nahor. Ano okwa tsu oongolo nokwa pandula Jehova oshoka okwe mu wilike okuya kaakwawo yaAbraham.

Uusiku mbono omupiya gwaAbraham okwa lombwele Betuel nomumwayina gwaRebeka Laban molwashike ye e ya po. Ayehe yaali oya zimine kutya Rebeka ota vulu okuya pamwe naye noku ka hokana naIsaak. Rebeka okwa ti shike sho a pulwa? Ye okwa ti: ‘Eeno,’ ye okwa hala okuya. Ano esiku lya landula ko oya londo oongamelo noya tameke olweendo olule okushuna kuKanaan.

Osha li ethimbo lyongulohi sho ya thiki hoka. Rebeka okwa mono omulumentu te ende melundu. Okwa li Isaak. Ye okwa li a nyanyukwa okumona Rebeka. Yina Sara opo owala a si konima yoomvula ndatu, nokwa li natango a nika oluhodhi kwaashino. Ihe ngashingeyi Isaak okwa tameke okukala e hole Rebeka noonkondo, nokwa li nelago ishewe. Genesis 24:1-67.

AAMATI yaali mbaka oya yoolokathana noonkondo, hasho mbela? Owa tseya tuu omadhina gawo? Omukongo oye Esau, nomumati ngoka ta tonatele oonzi oJakob.

Esau naJakob oya li aamati aakwanambwiyu yaIsaak naRebeka. He yawo, Isaak, okwa li e hole Esau noonkondo, oshoka okwa li omukongo omwaanawa ngoka a li he eta iikulya kegumbo yokuliwa kaakwanegumbo. Ihe Rebeka okwa li e hole unene Jakob, oshoka okwa li omumati omumweni nomunambili.



Hekulu Abraham okwa li natango e na omwenyo, notatu vulu okudhiladhila owala nkene Jakob a kala nenyanyu oku mu pulakena omanga ye ta popi kombinga yaJehova. Lwahugunina Abraham okwa si muukokele woomvula 175, sho aakwanambwiyu ya li ye na oomvula 15.

Sho Esau a li e na oomvula 40, ye okwa hokana naakiintu yaali yokoshilongo shaKanaan. Shika osha nikitha Isaak naRebeka oluhodhi noonkondo, oshoka aakiintu mbaka kaya li haa galikana nando Jehova.

Opo nduno esiku limwe sha osha ningwa po shoka sha geyithitha Esau omumwayina Jakob noonkondo. Ethimbo olya li lya thikana kuIsaak okulaleka nuuyamba omwanamati omukuluntu. Molwashoka Esau okwa li omukuluntu kuJakob, Esau okwa li a tegelela a taambe elaleko nuuyamba ndika. Ihe Esau okwa li a landitha po nale uuthemba okutaamba elaleko nuuyamba kuJakob. Kalunga wo okwa popi nale pevalo lyaamati yaali kutya Jakob ota ka taamba elaleko nuuyamba. Naashoka osho sha ningwa. Isaak okwa gandja elaleko nuuyamba komwanamati Jakob.

Konima sho Esau e shi uvu, ye okwa geyele Jakob noonkondo. Okwa li a geya ngaaka sho a ti kutya ye ota yi a ka dhipage Jakob. Sho Rebeka u uvu kombinga yaashino, okwa li a nika uuthigwa. Ano okwa lombwele omulumentu gwe Isaak: ‘Otashi ka kala oshinyanyalithi ngele Jakob naye wo okwa hokana nagumwe gwomaakiintu mbaka yokuKanaan.’

Opo tuu mpoka Isaak okwi ithana omwanamati Jakob nokwe mu lombwele: ‘Ino hokana nomukiintu gwokuKanaan. Pehala lyaashono inda kegumbo lyahokulu Betuel kuHaran. Hokana nagumwe gwomaakadhona yomwanamati Laban.’ Jakob okwa pulakene kuhe, nokwa tameke mbalambala okuya molweendo lwe olule okuya kaakwawo ya kala muHaran.

Genesis 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Aaheberi 12:16, 17.

OWA tseya kutya aalumentu mbaka taa popi naJakob oyo oolye? Konima yolweendo lwomasiku ogendji, Jakob okwa tsakanene nayo pomuthima. Oya li taa tonatele oonzi dhawo. Jakob okwa pula: ‘One oyapeni?’

‘OyokuHaran,’ osho yo ya ti.

‘Omwa tseya Laban?’ Jakob a pula.

‘Eeno,’ osho yo ya yamukula. ‘Tala, huka otaku zi omwanakadhona Rakel noshigunda she shoonzi.’ Oto vulu mbela okumona Rakel te ya ta zi kokule hwiya? Sho Jakob a mono Rakel noonzi dhahekulu Laban, okwa yi nokwa galangatitha po emanya pomuthima opo oonzi dhi vule okunwa. Opo nduno Jakob ta thipi Rakel komilungu nokwe mu lombwele kutya oye lye. Okwa li a kumwa noonkondo nokwa yi kegumbo nokwa hokololele he Laban.

Laban okwa li a nyanyukwa noonkondo okukala e na Jakob e li pamwe naye. Naashono Jakob a pula a hokane naRakel, Laban okwa li a nyanyukwa. Nonando ongaaka, ye okwa pula Jakob a longe mepya lye oomvula heyali molwaRakel. Molwashoka ye okwa li e hole Rakel unene ngaaka, Jakob osho a ningi. Ihe owa tseya tuu sho sha ningwa po sho ethimbo lyokuhokana lya thikana?

Laban okwa gandja omwanakadhona gwe osheeli Lea kuJakob pehala lyaRakel. Sho Jakob a zimine okulongela Laban oomvula oonkwawo heyali, Laban okwa gandja wo Rakel kuye oye omukiintu gwe. Pethimbo ndyono Kalunga okwa li a pitika aalumentu ya kale ye na aakiintu oyendji ye vulithe pugumwe. Ihe ngashingeyi, ngaashi Ombimbeli tayi holola, omulumentu e na okukala e na omukiintu gumwe owala. Genesis 29:1-30.

TALA owala kuukwanegumbo mbuka owindji. Mbaka oyo aamati 12 yaJakob. Nokwa li wo e na aakadhona. Owa tseya omadhina gayamwe yomaanona? Natu ilonge po gamwe gomugo.

Lea okwa vala Ruben, Simeon, Levi naJuda. Sho Rakel a mono kutya ye ita mono nando aanona, ye okwa li a nika oluhodhi noonkondo. Ano okwa gandja omudhike gwe Bilha kuJakob, Bilha nokwa mono aamati yaali, oyo Dan naNaftali. Opo nduno Lea wo okwa gandja omudhike gwe Silpa kuJakob, Silpa nokwa vala Gad naAsser. Lwahugunina Lea okwa mono natango aamati yaali, Isaskar naSebulon.

Lwahugunina Rakel okwa mono okanona. Okwe ka luku Josef. Konima otatu ki ilonga oshindji noonkondo kombinga yaJosef, oshoka ye okwa ningi omuntu a simana noonkondo. Mbaka oyo aamati 11 ya valelwa Jakob omanga a li a kala puhe yaRakel, Laban.

Jakob naye wo okwa li e na aakadhona yalwe, ihe Ombimbeli otayi gandja owala edhina lyagumwe gwomuyo. Edhina lye oDina.

Ethimbo olya thikana kutya Jakob a tokole okuthiga po Laban nokushuna kuKanaan. Ano okwa gongele uukwanegumbo we owindji niigunda ye yoonzi nomausita ge goongombe, nokwa tameke olweendo olule.

Konima sho Jakob nuukwanegumbo we ya kala uule wokathimbo muKanaan, Rakel okwa mono natango okamati kamwe. Shika osha ningwa manga yo ya li molweendo. Rakel okwa li a mono uudhigu owindji, nolwahugunina okwa si manga a li ta mono. Ihe okahanona okamati oka li ke li nawa. Jakob okwe ka luku Benjamin.

Tse otwa hala okudhimbulukwa omadhina gaamati 12 yaJakob, oshoka oshigwana ashihe shaIsrael osha zi muyo. Omazimo 12 gaIsrael oga lukilwa oyanamati 10 yaJakob noyanamati yaali yaJosef. Konima yokuvalwa kwaamati ayehe mbano Isaak okwa kala natango e na omwenyo oomvula odhindji, nosha li shi na oku mu nyanyudha okukala e na aatekulu aamati oyendji ngaaka. Ihe natu tale kutya oshike sha ningilwa omutekulu omukadhona Dina. Genesis 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35.

OU WETE mbono Dina ta yi a ka talele po? Ota yi a ka talele po yamwe yomaakadhona mboka ya kala moshilongo shaKanaan. He Jakob mbela okwa li ngaa e uvite enyanyu kombinga yaashino? Okuyamukula epulo ndino, kambadhala okudhimbulukwa shoka Abraham naIsaak ya li ya dhiladhila kombinga yaakiintu yomuKanaan. Mbela Abraham okwa li ngaa a hala omwanamati Isaak a hokane nomukadhona gwomuKanaan? Aawe, ka li a hala. Isaak naRebeka oya li ya hala tuu omwanamati gwawo Jakob a hokane nomukadhona Omukanaan? Aawe, kaya li ya hala. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike?

Osha li omolwashoka aantu mbaka yomuKanaan ohaya galikana iikalunga. Kaya li aantu aawanawa okukala oyo aalumentu aahokani naakiintu aahokanwa, nokaya li nando aantu aawanawa okukaliwa nayo oyo ookuume yopothingo. Ano otatu vulu okukala nuushili kutya Jakob ka li a nyanyukwa sho omwanakadhona a ningi uukuume naakadhona mbano Aakanaan.

Uushili owo kutya, Dina okwa yi muudhigu. Oto vulu mbela okumona omulumentu ngono Omukanaan mefano ngono ta tala kuDina? Edhina lye oSikem. Esiku limwe sho Dina a ka talela po hono, Sikem okwa kwata Dina nokwe mu thiminike ya lale naye. Shika osha li sha puka, molwashoka aalumentu naakiintu owala mboka ya hokana taa vulu okulala pamwe. Oshinima shika sha puka shoka Sikem a ningile Dina oshe eta uudhigu uunene.

Sho aamwayinamati yaDina yu uvu shoka sha ningwa po, oya li ya geya noonkondo. Yaali yomuyo, Simeon naLevi, oya li ya geya ngawo opo ihe oya yi nomagongamwele koshilando noya kwata aalumentu ye ya akele. Yo naamwayina aalumentu oya dhipaga Sikem naalumentu yalwe. Jakob okwa li a geya molwashoka oyanamati ya longo oshinima shika oshiwinayi.

Oshike sha li she etitha po uudhigu auhe mbuno? Osha li omolwashoka Dina a ningi uukuume naantu mboka inaaya vulika koompango dhaKalunga. Tse inatu hala ookuume ya tya ngawo, nenge hasho mbela? Genesis 34:1-31.

TALA nkene okamati ka sa oluhodhi nokaake na etegameno. Nguka oye Josef. Aamwahe opo ye mu landitha po kaalumentu mbaka mboka ye li mondjila yawo yokuEgipiti. Hoka Josef ota ka ninga omupika. Omolwashike aamwahe ya ningi oshinima shika oshiwinayi? Osha li omolwashoka oya li ya tsila Josef ondumbo.

He yawo Jakob okwa li e hole Josef unene noonkondo. Ye okwe mu lenge moku mu ningila onguwo ombwanawa onde. Sho aamwahe aakuluntu 10 ya mono nkene Jakob e hole unene Josef, yo oya tameke okutsila Josef ondumbo noku mu tonda. Ihe natango opwa li etompelo lilwe molwashike yo ye mu tondo.

Josef okwa yaguma oondjodhi mbali. Moondjodhi adhihe mbali dhaJosef aamwahe otayi isizimike kuye. Sho Josef a hokolele aamwahe oondjodhi ndhino, nokuli uutondwe wawo owa koko shi vulithe po.

Esiku limwe manga aamwahe yaJosef aakuluntu taa tonatele oonzi dhahe, Jakob ota pula Josef okuya a ka tale nkene ye li po. Sho aamwahe yaJosef ye mu wete te ya, yamwe yomuyo otaa ti: ‘Natu mu dhipageni!’ Ihe Ruben, omumwahe osheeli, ota ti: ‘Aawe, inamu ninga ngaaka!’ Pehala lyaashono otaya kwata Josef notaye mu dhaadhiga molumbogo lwaa na omeya. Opo nduno otaa kuutumba ya tokole shoka taye mu ningile. Pethimbo opo tuu mpono otapu piti aalumentu Aaismael. Juda ota ti kaamwahe: ‘Natu mu landithii po kAaismael.’ Naashika osho taa ningi. Yo otaa landitha po Josef kiisiliveli 20. Alikana, uuwinayi nonyanya yawo oya li yi thike peni!

Aamwahe otaya ka hokololela he shike? Otaa dhipaga oshikombo notaa yaya onguwo ombwanawa yaJosef mombinzi yoshikombo lwiikando oyindji. Opo nduno taya fala onguwo kegumbo kuhe Jakob notaa ti: ‘Otwe yi toola. Yi tala, nokumona ngele kayi shi onguwo yaJosef.’

Jakob oku wete kutya oyaJosef. ‘Oshilikama ngiika sha dhipaga Josef,’ osho ye ti igidha. Nosho naanaa aamwahe yaJosef ya hala he a dhiladhile. Jakob okwa sa oluhodhi olunenenene. Ye ota lili uule womasiku ogendji. Ihe Josef ina sa. Natu tale shoka she mu ningilwa hoka ye a falwa. Genesis 37:1-35.

JOSEF oku na owala oomvula 17 sho ye ta falwa kuEgipiti. Hoka ye ota landithwa po komulumentu gwedhina Potifar. Potifar oha longele omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, i ithanwa Farao.

Josef oha longele omwene gwe Potifar nuudhiginini. Ano Josef sho a koko, Potifar ote mu tula metonatelo lyegumbo lye alihe. Omolwashike nduno Josef e li mpaka mondholongo? Omolwomukiintu gwaPotifar.

Josef ota koko ta ningi omulumentu ngoka e na ondjelo ombwanawa, nomukiintu gwaPotifar okwa hala a lale naye. Ihe Josef oku shi kutya shika osha puka, nota tindi oku shi ninga. Omukiintu gwaPotifar ota geye noonkondo. Ano uuna omulumentu gwe ta galukile kegumbo, ote mu fundju nota ti: ‘Josef ngoka omwiinayi okwa kambadhala a lale nangame!’ Potifar okwi itaale omukiintu gwe, nota geyele Josef noonkondo. Ano ote mu edhilile mondholongo.

Mbala omulumentu omukuluntu gwondholongo ota mono kutya Josef omulumentu omwaanawa. Ano ote mu tula metonatelo lyoonkwatwa adhihe dhilwe. Konima Farao ota geyele omupindi gwe nomuyothi gwiikwiila gwe, note ya edhilile mondholongo. Uusiku wumwe ayehe yaali otaa yaguma ondjodhi, kehe gumwe oyi ili, ihe kaye shi shoka oondjodhi dhawo tadhi ti. Esiku lya landula Josef ota ti: ‘Hokololeni ndje oondjodhi dheni.’ Naashono taye shi ningi, kekwatho lyaKalunga Josef ote ya fatululile oondjodhi dhawo.

Komupindi Josef ota ti: ‘Konima yomasiku gatatu oto ka mangululwa mondholongo noto ka ninga ishewe omupindi gwaFarao.’ Ano Josef ota gwedha po: ‘Ngele wa zi mo, hokololela Farao kombinga yandje, nou kwathe ndje ndi ze mo mehala ndika.’ Ihe komuyothi gwiikwiila Josef ota ti: ‘Konima yomasiku owala gatatu Farao ota ka tetitha ko omutse gwoye.’

Konima yomasiku gatatu otashi ningwa naanaa ngaashi Josef a ti. Farao ota tetitha ko omutse gwomuyothi gwiikwiila. Ihe omupindi ota mangululwa mo mondholongo nota tameke okulongela ishewe omukwaniilwa. Ihe omupindi omukuluntu okwa dhimbwa thiluthilu kombinga yaJosef! Ye ita hokololele nando Farao kombinga ye, ano Josef oku na okukala mondholongo. Genesis 39:1-23; 40:1-23.

OOMVULA mbali otadhi piti po, naJosef natango onkene ngaa e li mondholongo. Omupindi omukuluntu ine mu dhimbulukwa. Opo nduno uusiku wumwe Farao ota yaguma oondjodhi mbali dhi ili lela, nokwa kumwa kutya otadhi ti shike. Ou mu wete mpano ta kotha? Ongula ya landula Farao oti ithanitha aalumentu ye aanandunge note ya hokololele iinima mbyoka ye a yaguma. Ihe yo itaa vulu oku mu fatululila oondjodhi dhe.

Lwahugunina omupindi omukuluntu opo ta dhimbulukwa Josef. Ye ota ti kuFarao: ‘Sho nda li mondholongo, omwa li omulumentu ngoka ha vulu okufatulula oondjodhi.’ Farao ota ka talitha mo Josef mondholongo mbalambala. Farao ota hokololele Josef oondjodhi dhe: ‘Onda mono oonzinzi heyali dho ondoka noombwanawa. Opo nduno onda mono oonzinzi heyali dha nanga noombwinayi. Naandhoka dha nanga odha li po oonzinzi heyali ndhoka dho ondoka.

‘Mondjodhi yandje ontiyali onda mono oonyapi heyali dha vala nawa dha mena moshihenguti shimwe. Opo nduno onda mono oonyapi heyali dha nanga nodha pela. Noonyapi dha nanga odha tameke okuninagula po oonyapi ndhoka heyali oombwanawa.’ Josef ota ti kuFarao: ‘Oondjodhi mbali odhi na eityo lya faathana. Oonzinzi dho ondoka heyali noonyapi heyali oombwanawa otashi ti oomvula heyali, noonzinzi heyali dha nanga noonyapi heyali dha nanga otashi ti oomvula heyali natango. Otapu ka kala oomvula heyali uuna iikulya oyindji tayi ka mena muEgipiti. Opo nduno otapu ka kala oomvula heyali uuna tamu ka mena iikulya iishona noonkondo.’

Ano Josef ota lombwele Farao: ‘Hogolola omulumentu omunandunge noku mu tula metonatelo lyokugongela iikulya pethimbo lyoomvula heyali oombwanawa. Opo nduno aantu itaa ka sa ondjala pethimbo lyoomvula heyali oondhigu tadhi ka landula sho tapu ka mena iikulya iishona.’

Farao edhiladhilo okwe li panda. Nota hogolola Josef a gongele iikulya, noku yi pungula miigandhi. Kakele kaFarao Josef ota ningi omulumentu a simana muEgipiti.

Konima yoomvula hetatu, pethimbo lyondjala onene, Josef ota mono aalumentu yontumba taye ya. Owa tseya kutya oyo oolye? Tala, oyo aamwahe aakuluntu 10! He yawo Jakob okwe ya tumu kuEgipiti oshoka iikulya yawo muKanaan oya li pokupwa po. Josef ota dhimbulula aamwahe, ihe yo itaye mu dhimbulula. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Osho molwashoka Josef okwa koka nokwa li a zala oonguwo dholudhi lumwe lwi ili.

Josef ota dhimbulukwa kutya sho a li okamati, okwa yagumine ondjodhi nkene aamwahe taye ya okwiisizimika kuye. Oto dhimbulukwa kutya owe shi lesha? Ano Josef ota vulu okumona kutya oye Kalunga ngoka e mu tumu kuEgipiti, nonetompelo ewanawa. Ngoye oto dhiladhila mbela kutya Josef ota ningi po shike? Natu tale. Genesis 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20.

JOSEF okwa hala okutseya ngele aamwahe 10 aakuluntu natango onkene ngaa aawinayi noye na onyanya. Ano ye ota ti: ‘One oondaadhi. Omwe ya okutala mpoka oshilongo shetu sha mbemba.’

‘Aawe, tse hatse,’ yo taa ti. ‘Tse aalumentu aanashili. Tse atuhe aamwayinathana. Otwa li 12. Ihe omumwatate gumwe ke po we, nonkelo oku li kegumbo kutate.’

Josef ota ningi a fa ongaa ngoka inee ya itaala. Ota tula omumwahe gwedhina Simeon mondholongo, note etha yalwe ya kuthe iikulya noya ye kegumbo. Ihe ote ya lombwele: ‘Uuna tamu galuka, omu na okweetelela ondenge yeni.’

Sho yo taa galukile kegumbo muKanaan, aamwahe otaa hoko-lolele he Jakob ashihe shoka sha ningwa po. Jakob okwa sa oluhodhi noonkondo. ‘Josef ke po we,’ osho ye ti igidha, ‘nongashingeyi Simeon ke po we. Itandi ka pitika nando mu kuthe omumwa-ndjemati onkelo Benjamin.’ Ihe sho iikulya yawo ya tameke okupwa po, Jakob okwe ya pitika ya ye pamwe naBenjamin kuEgipiti opo ya vule okumona natango iikulya.

Ngashingeyi Josef oku wete aamwahe taye ya. Ye ota nya-nyukwa noonkondo okumona ondenge Benjamin. Dhoshili, nando gumwe gwomuyo ta tseya kutya omulumentu nguka a simana oye Josef. Ngashingeyi Josef ota ningi po sha okumakela aamwahe 10.

Ote etha aapiya ye yu udhe oompunda dhawo adhihe iikulya. Ihe noinaaye shi tseya, ye ota tulitha wo oshitenga she shoshisiliveli shi ikalekelwa mompunda yaBenjamin. Konima sho ayehe ya yi noye ende ko okakako okashona, Josef ota tumu aapiya ye ye ya landule. Sho tuu taye ya adha, aapiya yo otaa ti: ‘Omolwashike mwa yakele po oshitenga shomwene gwetu shoshisiliveli?’

‘Tse inatu yaka po oshitenga she,’ aamwahe ayehe taa ti. ‘Ngele omwa adha oshitenga kugumwe gwomutse, omuntu ngoka e na okudhipagwa.’

Ano aapiya otaa kongo moompunda adhihe, notaya adha oshi-tenga mompunda yaBenjamin, ngaashi mu shi wete mpaka. Ano aapiya otaa ti: ‘Oshihupe shomune otamu vulu okuya, ihe Benjamin oku na okuya pamwe natse.’ Ngashingeyi aamwahe 10 otaa ka ninga po nee shike?

Yo ayehe otaa shuna pamwe naBenjamin kegumbo lyaJosef. Josef ota lombwele aamwahe: ‘Ne amuhe otamu vulu okushuna kegumbo, ihe Benjamin e na okukala mpaka oye omupika gwandje.’

Ngashingeyi Juda ota katuka onkatu e ta ti: ‘Ngele tandi shuna kegumbo ndaa na okamati, tate ota ka sa oshoka oku ka hole unene noonkondo. Alikana, kaleka ndje mpaka ongame omupika gwoye, ihe etha okamati ka shune kegumbo.’

Josef ota vulu okumona kutya aamwahe oya lunduluka. Yo kaye shi we aawinayi naakwanyanya. Natu tale shoka Josef ta ningi po ngashingeyi. Genesis 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34.

JOSEF ita vulu we okupangela omaiyuvo ge olule. Ye ota lombwele aapiya ye ayehe ya ze mo mondunda. Sho e li mo oye awike pamwe naamwahe, Josef ota tameke okulila. Otatu vulu okudhiladhila nkene aamwahe ya li ya kumwa, molwashoka yo itaaya tseya molwashike ye ta lilile. Lwahugunina ye ota ti: ‘Ongame Josef. Tate oku na omwenyo natango?’

Aamwahe oya kumwa ngaaka itaaya vulu okupopya. Yo oya tila. Ihe Josef ota ti: ‘Hedheni popepi alikana.’ Sho yo taye shi ningi, ye ota ti: ‘Ongame omumwaho Josef, ngoka mwa landithile po muEgipiti.’

Josef ota tsikile okupopya nombili: ‘Inamu ipa uusama ne yene molwashoka mwa landitha ndje po mpaka. Muushili wo wene osha li oKalunga ngoka a tumu ndje kuEgipiti okuhupitha oomwenyo dhaantu. Farao okwa ningi ndje omupangeli gwoshilongo ashihe. Ano ngashingeyi endeleleni mu shune kutate nomu mu hokololele shika. Nomu mu lombwele e ye noku kale mpaka.’

Opo nduno Josef ota papatele aamwahe nomaako ge, note ya idhingile note ya thipi komilungu ayehe. Sho Farao tu uvu kutya aamwahe yaJosef oye ya po, ye ota lombwele Josef: ‘Naya kuthe omatemba noya ka tale ko he nomaukwanegumbo gawo ye ye huka. Ngame otandi ke ya pa oshitopolwa oshiwanawa mevi lyaEgipiti alihe.’

Shika osho ya ningi. Mpaka ngoye oto vulu okumona nkene Josef ta tsakaneke he sho e ya kuEgipiti pamwe nuukwanegumbo we auhe. Uukwanegumbo waJakob owi indjipala noonkondo. Ayehe kumwe oya li 70 sho ya tembukile kuEgipiti, ngele tatu yalula Jakob naanona ye naatekulu. Ihe opwa li wo aakiintu, tashi vulika naapiya oyendjiyendji. Yo ayehe oya ka kala muEgipiti. Yo oyi ithanwa Aaisrael, oshoka Kalunga okwa lundululile edhina lyaJakob muIsrael. Aaisrael oya ningi aantu yi ili noonkondo kuKalunga, ngaashi tatu ke shi mona nale. Genesis 45:1-28; 46:1-27.

NGOYE ou uvitile mbela omulumentu nguka te ehama ohenda? Edhina lye oJob, naangoka a thikama mpaka puye omukiintu gwe. Owa tseya mbela shoka ta lombwele Job? ‘Tuka Kalunga u se.’ Natu tale kutya omolwashike ye a popi iinima ya tya ngaaka iinyanyalithi, nomolwashike Job e li muuwehame uunene ngawo.

Job okwa li omulumentu omudhiginini ngoka a vulika kuJehova. Ye okwa kala moshilongo shaUs, popepi naKanaan. Jehova okwa li e hole Job unene, ihe opwa li gumwe ngoka e mu tonde. Owa tseya kutya oye lye?

Oye Satana Ondiaboli. Dhimbulukwa, Satana oye omuyengeli omwiinayi ngoka e tonde Jehova. Ye okwa ningitha Adam naEva ya kale inaaya vulika kuJehova, nokwa li ta dhiladhila kutya ye ota vulu okuningitha aantu ayehe ya kale ihaaya vulika kuJehova. Ihe okwe shi vulile ngaa mbela? Aawe. Dhiladhila owala kaalumentu naakiintu ayehe aadhiginini mboka twi ilongo kombinga yawo. Yangapi ngoye to vulu okutumbula po?

Konima sho Jakob naJosef ya si muEgipiti, Job okwa li omuntu ngoka omudhiginini unene muJehova kombanda yevi alihe. Jehova okwa li a hala a tseyithe Satana kutya ye ita vulu a ningithe ayehe ya kale aawinayi, ano ye okwa ti: ‘Tala kuJob. Tala nkene a dhiginina mungame.’

‘Ye omudhiginini,’ Satana ta patana, ‘molwashoka owe mu laleke nuuyamba noku na iinima oyindji iiwanawa. Ihe ngele owe yi kutha po, ote ke ku tuka.’

Ano Jehova okwa ti: ‘Tsikila. Yi kutha po. Ningila Job iinima ayihe iiwinayi mbyoka ngoye wa hala. Otatu ka tala ngele ota ka tuka ndje. Sa owala oshimpwiyu opo waahe mu dhipage.’ Tango, Satana okwa yakitha po oongombe noongamelo dhaJob kaantu, noonzi dhe odha dhipagwa po. Opo nduno a dhipagitha po oyanamati 10 naakadhona ye koshikungulu. Konima Satana oku umbu Job uuvu uunyanyalithi. Job okwa kala muuwehame uunene. Osho molwashoka omukiintu gwaJob a ti kuye: ‘Tuka Kalunga u se.’ Ihe Job okwa tindi oku shi ninga. Natango ookuume ke aaniifundja oye ya noye mu lombwele kutya ye okwa li a kala nonkalamwenyo ombwinayi. Ihe Job okwa kala a dhiginina.

Shika osha nyanyudha Jehova noonkondo, nokonima ye okwa laleke Job nuuyamba, ngaashi to vulu oku shi mona mefano. Ye okwe mu aludha kuuvu we. Job okwa li natango e na aanona 10 aawanawa, nosho wo oongombe, oonzi noongamelo oyindji lwaali yi vulithe nale.

Ngoye oto ka kala ngaa aluhe omudhiginini muJehova ngaashi Job? Ngele osho, Kalunga ote ke ku laleka wo nuuyamba. Ngoye oto vulu oku ka kala nomwenyo sigo aluhe uuna evi alihe tali ka ningwa ewanawa ngaaka ngaashi oshikunino shaEden. Job 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17.

AALUMENTU mbaka otaya thiminike aantu ya longe. Tala komulumentu ngoka ta dhenge gumwe gwomaalongi nongola! Aalongi oyo aakwanezimo lyaJakob, noyi ithanwa Aaisrael. Naalumentu mboka taye ya thiminike ya longe oyo Aaegipiti. Aaisrael oya ningi aapika yAaegipiti. Ongiini shika sha ningwa?

Uule woomvula odhindji uukwanegumbo waJakob owa kala nombili muEgipiti. Josef, ngoka a li omulumentu a simana unene muEgipiti kakele komukwaniilwa Farao, okwa li e ya sile oshimpwiyu. Ihe opo tuu mpono Josef okwa si. Farao omupe, ngoka kee hole Aaisrael, nokwa ningi omukwaniilwa muEgipiti.

Ano Farao nguka omwiinayi okwa ningi Aaisrael aapika. Nokwa tula po aalumentu aawinayi naakwanyanya ye ya tonatele. Yo oya thiminike Aaisrael ya longe noonkondo okutungila Farao iilando. Ihe Aaisrael oya tsikile nokwiindjipala. Konima yokathimbo Aaegipiti oya tila kutya Aaisrael otayi indjipala noonkondo notaya nkondopala unene. Owa tseya mbela shoka Farao a ningi po? Okwa popi naakiintu mboka haa kwathele aakulukadhi Aaisrael uuna taa mono aanona, nokwa ti: ‘Omu na okudhipaga okamati kehe taka valwa.’ Ihe oya li aakiintu aawanawa, yo inaya dhipaga uuhanona.

Ano Farao okwa lombwele oshigwana she ashihe: ‘Kutheni uuhanona uumati Uuisrael noku wu dhipaga. Uuhanona uukadhona auke u kale u na omwenyo.’ Mbela kasha li nando elombwelo enyanyalithi? Natu tale nkene kamwe komuuhanona uumati ka hupithwa. Eksodus 1:6-22.

TALA nkene okahanona taka lili, notaka kwata omunwe gwomukiintu. Oko Moses. Owa tseya mbela kutya omukiintu ngoka omwaanawa oye lye? Oye omuna gwokombanda Omuegipiti, omwanakadhona gwaFarao mwene.

Yina yaMoses okwa holeke okahanona ke sigo ko ka ningi oomwedhi ndatu, oshoka ye ka li a hala Aaegipiti ye ka dhipage. Ihe ye okwa kala e shi shi kutya ngiika yo Moses otaye ke mu mona. Tala shoka ye a ningi po opo e mu hupithe.

Ye okwa kutha oshimbamba nokwe shi hoto opo omeya kaage ye meni. Opo nduno a tula Moses meni, nokwa tula oshimbamba momwiidhi omule pooha nOmulonga gwaNil. Omumwayinakadhona gwaMoses, Miriam, okwa li a lombwelwa a thikame mpoka popepi nokutala shoka tashi ningwa po. Mbala omwanakadhona gwaFarao okwe ya kOmulonga gwaNil okwiiyoga. Ombadhilila okwa mono oshimbamba momwiidhi omule. Okwi ithana gumwe gwomaakadhona aapiya ye nokwa ti: ‘Ka talele ndje oshimbamba shiyaka.’ Sho omuna gwokombanda a siikulula oshimbamba, alikana okahanona okawanawa ngiini hoka ye a mono! Moses okashona oka li ka lila, nomuna gwokombanda okwa li e ka uvitile ohenda. Ye ka li a hala ko ka dhipagwe.

Opo nduno Miriam okwe ya popepi. Oto vulu oku mu mona mefano. Miriam okwa pula omwanakadhona gwaFarao: ‘Nandi ye ndi ki ithane omukiintu Omwiisrael oku ku yamuthila okahanona?’

‘Alikana shi ninga,’ omuna gwokombanda osho a ti.

Miriam okwa matuka mbala nokwa hokololele yina. Sho yina yaMoses e ya komuna gwokombanda, omuna gwokombanda okwa ti: ‘Kutha po okahanona nkaka nou ka yamuthile ndje, notandi ke ku futa.’

Ano yina yaMoses okwa tonatele okanona ke mwene. Konima sho Moses a koko, okwe mu fala komwanakadhona gwaFarao, naanguka okwe mu taamba ngaashi omwanamati gwe mwene. Shika osho sha ningwa po opo Moses a putukile megumbo lyaFarao. Eksodus 2:1-10.

TALA nkene Moses ta yi ontuku okuza muEgipiti. Oto vulu mbela okumona aalumentu mboka taye mu tidha? Owa tseya kutya omolwashike yo ya hala okudhipaga Moses? Natu tale ngele otatu vulu oku shi mona mo.

Moses okwa kokela megumbo lyaFarao, omupangeli gwaEgipiti. Ye okwa ningi omulumentu omunandunge noonkondo nokwa simana unene. Moses okwa li a tseya kutya ye ke shi Omweegipiti, ihe aakuluntu ye yolela oyo ya li aapika Aaisrael.

Esiku limwe, sho a li e na oomvula 40, Moses okwa tokola okuya a ka tale nkene oshigwana she shi li po. Yo oya li ya ningwa nayi oshitilithi. Ye okwa mono nkene Omweegipiti ta dhenge omupika Omwiisrael. Moses okwa lengalenga, naashono a mono kutya kapu na gumwe e mu wete, ye okwa dhenge Omweegipiti, Omweegipiti nokwa si. Opo nduno Moses okwa file olutu lwe mehekevi.

Esiku lya landula Moses okwa yi a ka talele po ishewe oshigwana she. Ye okwa li ta dhiladhila kutya ota vulu oku ya kwatha opo yaaha kale we aapika. Ihe ye okwa mono aalumentu yaali Aaisrael taa kondjo, ano Moses okwa ti kugumwe ngoka a li e na ondjo: ‘Omolwashike to dhengele omu-mwaho?’

Omulumentu okwa ti: ‘Olye e ku ningi omupangeli nomutokoli gwetu? Wa hala u dhipage ndje naanaa ngaashi wa dhipaga Omweegipiti ngwiyaka?’

Opo nduno Moses okwa tila. Okwa tseya kutya aantu oye shi mona shoka ye a ningile Omweegipiti. Nokuli Farao oku uvu kombinga yaashono nokwa tumu aalumentu ya ka dhipage Moses. Osho molwashono Moses a li e na okuya ontuku okuza muEgipiti.

Sho Moses a thigi po Egipiti, okwa yi kokule koshilongo shaMidian. Hoka ye okwa tsakanene nuukwanegumbo waJetro, nokwa hokana nagumwe gwomaakadhona ye Sipora. Moses okwa ningi omusita gwoonzi nokwa tonatele oonzi dhaJetro. Ye okwa kala uule woomvula 40 moshilongo shaMidian. Pethimbo ndyono ye okwa li e na oomvula 80. Opo nduno esiku limwe manga Moses a tonatele oonzi dhaJetro, oshinima oshikumithi osha ningwa po shoka sha lundulula onkalamwenyo yaMoses ayihe. Yanuna ko notu tale oshinima shika oshikumithi kutya oshike. Eksodus 2:11-25; Iilonga 7:22-29.

MOSES okwe ya okuza kokule sigo okondundu ndjino Horeb okukonga omwiidhi gwoonzi dhe. Mpaka okwa mono oshihwa sha hwama, ihe kasha li tashi pi po!

‘Shika inashi monika nale shi,’ Moses osho a dhiladhila. ‘Otandi hedha popepi ndi shi tale nawa.’ Sho e shi ningi, ewi olya zi moshihwa, tali ti: ‘Ino hedha popepi. Hula ko oongaku dhoye, oshoka owa thikama pevi eyapuki.’ Osha li oKalunga ta popi okupitila momuyengeli, ano Moses okwa siikile oshipala she.

Opo nduno Kalunga okwa ti: ‘Onda mono okuhepekwa kwoshigwana shandje muEgipiti. Ano otandi ke shi mangulula, nongoye gumwe ngoka tandi tumu okuwilika oshigwana shandje okuza muEgipiti.’ Jehova okwa li te ke eta oshigwana she moshilongo oshiwanawa shaKanaan.

Ihe Moses okwa ti: ‘Ongame olye? Ongiini ngame tandi vulu okulonga shika? Ihe nandi tye otandi yi. Aaisrael otaya ka tya kungame: “Olye e ku tumu?” Otandi ka tya nduno ngiini?’

‘Shika osho u na okutya,’ Kalunga a yamukula. ‘“JEHOVA Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsaak naKalunga kaJakob oye a tumu ndje kune.”’ Jehova nokwa gwedha ko: ‘Ndika olyo edhina lyandje sigo aluhe.’

‘Ihe natu tye itayi itaale ndje uuna tandi ti ongoye wa tumu ndje,’ Moses a yamukula.

‘Oshike shi li moshikaha shoye?’ Kalunga a pula.

Moses okwa yamukula: ‘Ondhimbo.’

‘Yi dhaadhiga pevi,’ Kalunga a ti. Naashono Moses e shi ningi, ondhimbo oya ningi eyoka. Opo nduno Jehova oku ulukile Moses oshikumithalonga shimwe. Ye okwa ti: ‘Homeka oshikaha shoye monguwo yoye.’ Moses okwe shi ningi, naashono a kutha mo oshikaha she, osha li sha toka to! Oshikaha osha li sha fa shi niwe kuuvu uuwinayi wuulepera. Konima Jehova okwa pe Moses oonkondo okulonga oshikumithalonga oshititatu. Lwahugunina okwa ti: ‘Uuna to ka longa iikumithalonga mbika, Aaisrael otaye ki itaala kutya ongame nde ku tumu.’

Konima yaashika Moses okwa yi kegumbo nokwa ti kuJetro: ‘Alikana pitika ndje ndi shune kaakwetu kuEgipiti ndi ka tale nkene ye li po.’ Ano Jetro okwa laleke Moses, Moses nokwa tameke olweendo lwe okushuna kuEgipiti. Eksodus 3:1-22; 4:1-20.

SHO Moses a galukile kuEgipiti, okwa hokololele omumwayina Aaron ayihe kombinga yiikumithalonga mbyoka. Naashono Moses naAaron yu ulukile Aaisrael iikumithalonga mbika, aantu ayehe oyi itaale kutya Jehova oku li pamwe nayo.

Opo nduno Moses naAaron oya yi ya ka talele po Farao. Oya ti kuye: ‘Jehova Kalunga kaIsrael ota ti: “Etha oshigwana shandje shi ye omasiku gatatu, opo shi vule okugalikana ndje mombuga.” ’ Ihe Farao okwa yamukula: ‘Ngame inandi itaala muJehova. Noitandi ke etha Israel sha ye.’

Farao okwa li a geya, omolwashoka aantu oya li ya hala ya mone efudho pethimbo lyiilonga ya galikane Jehova. Ano okwe ya thiminike ya longe nokuli noonkondo adhihe. Aaisrael oya pe Moses uusama molweningwo lyawo lyonayi, naMoses okwa li a sa oluhodhi. Ihe Jehova okwe mu lombwele kaa nike uuthigwa. ‘Otandi ka thiminika Farao e ethe oshigwana shandje shi ye,’ Jehova osho a ti. Moses naAaron oya yi ishewe kuFarao. Oshikando shino oya longo oshikumithalonga. Aaron oku umbile ondhimbo ye pevi, noya ningi eyoka. Ihe aalumentu aanongo yaFarao nayo oyu umbile oondhimbo dhawo pevi, nopwa holoka omayoka. Ihe tala! Eyoka lyaAaron otali li po omayoka gaalumentu aanongo. Natango Farao ina hala e ethe Aaisrael ya ye.

Ano ethimbo olya thikana kuJehova a longe Farao oshilongwa. Owa tseya kutya oshike ye a ningi po? Ye okwe eta omageelo nenge omaupyakadhi omanene 10 kuEgipiti.

Konima yomageelo gontumba, Farao okwa tumu kuMoses e ta ti: ‘Hulitha po egeelo, ngame notandi ke etha Aaisrael ya ye.’ Ihe sho egeelo lya hulu po, Farao okwa lundulula edhiladhilo lye. Ye ine etha nando oshigwana shi ye. Ihe lwahugunina, konima yegeelo eti-10, Farao okwa tumu Aaisrael ya ye.

Owa tseya tuu kehe limwe lyomomageelo 10 kutya olya li shike? Yanuna ko nou tale kutya oga li shike. Eksodus 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13.

TALA komafano. Kehe limwe otali ulike egeelo limwe ndyoka Jehova e eta muEgipiti. Mefano lyotango oto vulu okumona nkene Aaron ta dhenge mOmulonga gwaNil nondhimbo ye. Sho e shi ningi, omeya momulonga oga lundulukile mombinzi. Oohi odha si, nomulonga ogwa tameke okunika. Lya landula ko, Jehova okwa etitha omafuma okuza mOmulonga gwaNil. Oga li shaampono—momasiga, miipana yokukanga, moombete dhaantu—shaampono. Sho omafuma ga si, Aaegipiti oye ga gongele oondumba oonene, noshilongo osha li tashi nika molwago.

Opo nduno Aaron okwa dhenge pevi nondhimbo ye, nontsi oya lundulukile muumbululu. Mbuka owo uupuka uushona uutuki mboka hau lumata. Uumbululu owo wa li egeelo etitatu lya adha oshilongo shaEgipiti. Oshihupe shomageelo osha li sha gumu owala Aaegipiti, haAisrael. Egeelo etine olya li oondhi oonene ndhoka dha li dha tuka momagumbo gAaegipiti ayehe. Egeelo etitano olya gumu iinamwenyo. Oongombe noonzi odhindji niikombo oyindji yAaegipiti oya si.

Lya landula ko, Moses naAaron oya kutha omutoko noye gu umbu mombanda. Ogwe eta iitumbuka iiwinayi kaantu nokiinamwenyo. Ndika olya li egeelo etihamano.

Konima yaashika Moses okwa ganeke oshikaha she pombanda, Jehova nokwa tumu omindundumo noompawe. Osha li oshikungulu shoompawe sha kwata miiti shoka inaashi kala mo nale muEgipiti. Egeelo etihetatu olya li ongundu onene yoombahu. Kapwa li nando natango nale nenge konima oombahu odhindji ngawo. Dho odha li po ashihe shoka inaashi hanagulwa po koompawe.

Egeelo etimugoye olya li omilema. Uule womasiku gatatu opwa li omilema omidhigu dha siikile oshilongo, ihe Aaisrael oya li ye na uuyelele mpoka ya li. Lwahugunina, Kalunga okwa lombwele oshigwana she shi shashamine ombinzi yoshikombo oshigundjuka nenge yonzi ongundjuka piikulo yomiyelo dhawo. Opo nduno omuyengeli gwaKalunga okwe ende muEgipiti. Uuna omuyengeli a mono ombinzi, ina dhipaga nando ogumwe gwomegumbo moka. Ihe momagumbo agehe moka ombinzi ya li yaa po piikulo yomiyelo, omuyengeli gwaKalunga okwa dhipaga iisheeli yaantu nosho wo yiinamwenyo. Ndika olya li egeelo eti-10.

Konima yegeelo ndika lyahugunina, Farao okwa lombwele Aaisrael ya ye. Oshigwana shaKalunga osha li shi ilongekidha okuya, nuusiku owo tuu mboka osha tameke okuza muEgipiti. Eksodus ontopolwa 7 sigo 12.

TALA shoka tashi ningwa! Oye Moses ngoka ta ganeke ondhimbo ye kombanda yEfuta Etiligane. Aantu mboka ya gamenwa pamwe naye handiyaka, oyo Aaisrael. Ihe Farao netanga lye lyaakwiita ayehe otaa si omeya mefuta. Natu tale nkene shika sha ningwa.

Ngaashi twi ilongo, Farao okwa lombwele Aaisrael ya thige po Egipiti konima sho Kalunga e eta egeelo eti-10 kAaegipiti. Aalumentu Aaisrael ye thike lwopo 600 000 oya yi, nosho wo aakiintu naanona oyendji. Osho wo omwaalu omunene gwaantu yalwe, mboka ya tameke okwiitaala muJehova, ogwa yi pamwe nAaisrael. Yo ayehe oya yi pamwe noonzi dhawo niikombo yawo noongombe dhawo.

Manga inaaya ya, Aaisrael oya pula Aaegipiti oonguwo niinima yoshingoli noyoshisiliveli. Aaegipiti oya li ya tila noonkondo molwegeelo lyahugunina ndyoka lye ya adha. Ano oya gandja kAaisrael ayihe mbyoka yo ya pula.

Konima yomasiku gamwe po Aaisrael oye ya pEfuta Etiligane. Oya vululukwa po mpoka. Pethimbo opo tuu mpoka Farao naalumentu ye oya tameke okuuva nayi sho yo ye etha Aaisrael ya ye. ‘Otwe etha aapika yetu ya ye!’ osho yo ya ti.

Ano Farao okwa lundulula ishewe edhiladhilo lye. Mbala ye okwa longekidha omatembalugodhi ge netanga lye lyaakwiita. Nokwa tameke okulandula Aaisrael nomatembalugodhi gi ikalekelwa 600, nosho wo omatembalugodhi agehe galwe gAaegipiti.

Sho Aaisrael ya mono kutya Farao netanga lye lyaakwiita oye ya landula, oya li ya tila noonkondo. Yo oya li ya kondekwa. Efuta Etiligane olya li kombinga yimwe, naahuka kombinga onkwawo otaku zi Aaegipiti. Ihe Jehova okwa tula po oshikogo pokati koshigwana she nAaegipiti. Ano Aaegipiti kaya li taya vulu okumona Aaisrael opo ye ya ponokele.

Opo nduno Jehova okwa lombwele Moses a ganeke ondhimbo ye kombanda yEfuta Etiligane. Sho ye e shi ningi, Jehova okwa pepitha ombepo ondhigu yokuuzilo. Omeya gefuta oga topoka, nomeya oga kala ga kankama koombinga adhihe mbali.

Aaisrael oya tameke nduno okweenda pevi ekukutu okupita mefuta. Osha pula ethimbo ele kaantu omamiliyona pamwe niinamwenyo yawo ya thike nombili kombinga ndjiyaka yefuta. Lwahugunina Aaegipiti oya li taa vulu okumona ishewe Aaisrael. Aapika yawo oya li yi ipyakidhila okuya ontuku! Ano oya mbulukutile mefuta ye ya landule.

Sho ye shi ningi, Kalunga okwa gwitha ko omagulu goma-tembalugodhi gawo. Aaegipiti oya li ya tila noonkondo noya tameke okwiigidha: ‘Jehova ota kondjele Aaisrael oku tu kondjitha. Natu zeni mo muka!’ Ihe kapwa li we ompito.

Shika osha li sho Jehova a lombwele Moses a ganeke ondhimbo ye kombanda yEfuta Etiligane, ngaashi u shi wete mefano. Naashono Moses e shi ningi, omakuma gomeya oga tameke okushuna kumwe noga siikile Aaegipiti nomatembalugodhi gawo. Etanga lyaakwiita alihe olya landula Aaisrael mefuta. Nokapu na nando ogumwe gwomAaegipiti a zi mo nomwenyo! Alikana oshigwana shaKalunga osha li sha nyanyukwa ngiini sho sha hupithwa! Aalumentu oyi imbile Jehova eimbilo lyepandulo e taa ti: ‘Jehova okwa sindana esindano ekumithi. Okwa dhaadhiga oonkambe naalondi yadho mefuta.’ Omumwayinakadhona gwaMoses Miriam okwa kutha ontunda ye, naakiintu ayehe oye mu landula noontunda dhawo. Nomanga yo taa tanta molwenyanyu, oyi imbi eimbilo lya faathana nolyaalumentu: ‘Jehova okwa sindana esindano ekumithi. Okwa dhaadhiga uukambe naalondi yawo mefuta.’ Eksodus ontopolwa 12 sigo 15.
